title: Claude Skills, MCP, Plugins, CLI & Artifacts Explained (2026)  #coding #programming #chatgpt
description:
Skills, MCP, plugins, CLI, artifacts... everyone throws these words around and nobody tells you what they actually do.

So here's the whole map.

Skills teach Claude a job,
MCP plugs it into your tools,
plugins bundle the lot,
CLI runs it in your terminal,
artifacts hand you a live preview 🔥

Learn all five and Claude stops being a chatbot and starts being your whole stack.

Comment "Claude" and I'll send you the full breakdown in your DMs.
